race.comment: THE DUX NUTS (4) has been around the mark in many of his runs. He came from beyond midfield at Tamworth to not be beaten far. Should easily improve on that now. WHAT A SCANDAL (12) did run in some decent races as a juvenile before a break. They add the tongue tie this time which can aid in improvement. CITY GOLD SPEED (8) was a lot better at Dubbo. He just has a poor strike rate. Does run well this track. HARVEY'S TURN (2) got the maiden out of the way three weeks ago. Gains confidence from that. KERMITISAPET (9) finished in the money last start running third at this track and should strip fitter second up, rates one of the chances.
